summary: Probe persistence matches the blueprint: migration 0003, probe-first budgeted ingestion, standalone reader with corrupt-vs-absent split. Contract clean, tests honest.
notes: contract-check ok=true; violations: none; not_checked: forbid.behaviors (reviewed by hand below).

acceptance-coverage status=pass, zero gaps; AC-1..AC-9 all mapped to blueprint scenarios. Two 'legacy_untracked' entries are the spec's unstructured tail strings (toolchain criterion and DEFERRED list), not real gaps.

Scope: 9 files, +818/-50 (786 tracked + 32 in the untracked 0003 SQL). Files exactly at the max_files_changed=9 limit; every per_class budget respected (migraciones 32/90, storage src 106/320, storage tests 383/620, hexcell src 42/160, hexcell tests 305/380).

MIGRATION: 0003-sonda-semantica.sql is one new rung (PasoDeMigracion version 3) on the EXISTING ladder. Verified in migraciones.rs aplicar(): the DDL execute_batch and the 'PRAGMA user_version = 3' bump run inside the same unchecked_transaction and commit together. No new ladder mechanism, no bespoke transaction, no user_version set outside the runner. Table is a STRICT singleton with the exact spec'd shape and no seed row; file contains no INSERT/ALTER/DROP/PRAGMA.

MIGRATION TEST (HEX-051-c lessons): the v2->v3 test seeds documentos -> fragmentos -> vectores_de_fragmento in FK-safe order (the workspace builds with -DSQLITE_DEFAULT_FOREIGN_KEYS=1) and rewrites metadatos_de_epoca dimension 768 -> 4, avoiding the trap the contract named. It asserts documento content and the vector BLOB survive byte-identical, sonda_semantica exists and is empty, and version equals the CONSTANT (no literal 3 anywhere). Re-apply is a genuine no-op: the runner skips rungs <= user_version, and if it did not, CREATE TABLE would error and the .expect() would fail.

STRICT GUARD: OBJETOS_ESPERADOS_DE_CONOCIMIENTO grew 5 -> 6 including sonda_semantica as a fixed-size array, so a missing table fails the fresh-migration loop. The STRICT assertion enumerates tables dynamically via pragma_table_list (not the array), so the new table is covered with no edit.

ORDER OF SPENDING: order in ejecutar_ingesta is crear -> probe batch -> fragment loop, exactly as the contract requires (crear must stay first because it destroys prior staging). Proven by an order-sensitive assertion, not a comment: ac_3's per-request size ledger changed from vec![2,2,1] to vec![1,2,2,1] and the request counter 3 -> 4, on both the OpenRouter and Gemini fake-server paths. The leading 1 is the probe and it is first.

PROBE-FAILURE PATH: ac_5_fallo_al_incrustar_sonda_aborta_ingesta_sin_gastar_en_fragmentos asserts ErrorDeIngesta::Embeddings (panicking on any other variant), exactly 1 reservation total, 0 active (budget released), and 0 fragments in staging. registrar_sonda_semantica is unreachable before a successful embed, so no probe row can exist on that path.

BUDGET: the probe goes through the existing ServicioDeEmbeddings::incrustar_lote. No second accounting path, no direct provider call, no separate metering. ac_6 correctly tightened total_reservas 1 -> 2 to account for the probe reservation.

ZERO-EMBEDDINGS: finalizar's else branch deletes sonda_semantica alongside descartar_metadatos_de_epoca in the same code path. Tested directly by verificar_descarte_de_sonda_semantica_cuando_no_hay_incrustaciones, which registers a probe, finalizes with no fragments, and asserts BOTH tables at zero rows.

CORRUPT VS ABSENT: leer_sonda_semantica maps only rusqlite QueryReturnedNoRows to Ok(None). Decode failure -> Err(SondaSemanticaIlegible); every other rusqlite error (type mismatch, missing table, I/O) -> Err via ErrorDeAlmacen::en. No failure mode returns Ok(None). Tested with a hand-built table lacking the CHECK holding a 5-byte BLOB, matching the exact variant and panicking on anything else. Decode reuses hexcell_core VectorDeEmbedding::desde_bytes_le; no hand-rolled byte handling on read.

MINOR (defense-in-depth, not a defect): desde_bytes_le accepts a zero-length slice (0 % 4 == 0) and returns Some(empty vector), so an externally corrupted zero-length BLOB would yield Ok(Some(vector: [])) rather than Err. Unreachable for any file this code writes because the column CHECK enforces length > 0, and a dimension-0 probe is rejected downstream by the already-merged MotivoDeRechazo::DimensionDeLaSondaDiscrepante. It cannot masquerade as Ok(None) and cannot produce a false approval, so the task's central invariant holds.

READER: single read-only open via the existing pub(crate) pools::abrir_solo_lectura (missing file is Err, tested). Standalone pub fn, not folded into ResumenDeInspeccion, so Eq is preserved there. Returns crate::validacion::SondaResuelta via an intra-crate use; validacion.rs and tests/validacion.rs have zero diff, confirmed by the contract guard and by git status.

AC-9 HANDOFF: verificar_entrega_de_sonda_leida_al_validador_de_integridad passes the reader's output unmodified into validar_integridad_del_indice and asserts Aprobado, then asserts a dimension-8-vs-4 probe is Rechazado by the existing DimensionDeLaSondaDiscrepante. Ingestion adds no dimension check of its own; it only REPORTS via the new field.

TYPES: ResumenDeIngesta keeps #[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)] and the new field is dimension_de_la_sonda: Option<usize>, filled from vector_sonda.dimension() (the actual decoded probe length), not an f32 and not a guess.

ARGUMENT COUNT: ejecutar_ingesta lands on exactly 7 parameters, the clippy::too_many_arguments limit with zero headroom. No #[allow] anywhere in the touched files (grep confirms none) and no struct bundling; clippy -D warnings passes on merit.

CALL SITES: all 10 call sites in tests/ingesta.rs moved to the new signature with explicit, test-local probe text and thresholds (no const, no default, no unwrap_or - guard confirms). Values are modest but not noise, and critically the pre-existing assertions were TIGHTENED rather than loosened to absorb the extra batch (ac_3 counter and size ledger, ac_6 reservation count).

DEVIATION FLAGGED FOR THE HUMAN: ac_5 Escenario B was rewritten from ProveedorDeEmbeddingsSimulado::con_limite_elementos(0) to the pre-existing local fake HTTP server (ProveedorDeEmbeddingsOpenRouter on 127.0.0.1), which literally touches the forbid.behaviors clause 'never bind a socket'. It is necessary and well-reasoned: con_limite_elementos truncates every response, so NO Simulado configuration can express 'probe succeeds, fragments resolve to zero' without editing crates/hexcell/src/embeddings.rs, a forbidden file. The helper already exists and is used by ac_3 on main, the API key is a literal, and the test stays fully offline. The clause's purpose (no live API, no env key, no egress) is honored. Escenario B retains all its original assertions (SinIncrustaciones, 0 fragments, metadatos_de_epoca absent, source document survives).

SOFT OBSERVATION: ac_4's own ordering assertion (reservas[0].estado == 'conciliada') does not by itself distinguish a probe reservation from a fragment one; the real order proof is ac_3's positional ledger. Not worth a fix task given ac_3 covers it.

LANGUAGE: all new SQL comments, doc comments and identifiers are Spanish and didactic (the 0003 header explains WHY a separate table rather than columns on metadatos_de_epoca, and restates the little-endian byte contract without redefining it), with the absolute date '30 de agosto de 2026'.

KNOWN DEFERRED, NOT A DEFECT: docs/STATUS.md line 26 still states the knowledge schema is at version 2 and goes stale on merge. docs/ is forbidden in this contract; the orchestrator fixes it at the merge gate.

No later-A-5 work leaked in: no promotion, checkpoint-and-rename, symlink, ArcSwap, drain, retention/revert, RAG, admin endpoint, stress test or backup interaction. No new ADR, no serde, no async in hexcell-storage, no rusqlite in hexcell/hexcell-core.
